name: odysseus
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Noryx AI instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Noryx AI tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Noryx AI through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Noryx AI Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Noryx AI only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
